WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "income"."link_to_member" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "income" GROUP BY "income"."link_to_member"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m1" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "major"."department" AS g, SUM("income"."amount") AS m1 FROM "income" JOIN "member" ON "member"."member_id" = "income"."link_to_member" JOIN "major" ON "major"."major_id" = "member"."link_to_major" GROUP BY "major"."department"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "member"."position" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "member"  GROUP BY "member"."position"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL
